@@ -61,7 +61,7 @@
                 end

parsed_output.root_cause: In state S_SIDE_GREEN, the transition condition '!car_present || (timer_cnt == TICKS_GREEN - 1'b1)' incorrectly uses TICKS_GREEN instead of TICKS_YELLOW for the side green phase duration. This causes the FSM to transition to S_SIDE_YELLOW prematurely during test_fsm_full_traffic_cycle, leading to a state_debug mismatch at 245ns.
